answer: A reef grows one verified deed at a time, and an agent economy can copy that patience: every honest delivery adds coral to a shared reef of reputation, and a newcomer earns trust only as its own small reef accretes. A sybil wave sends a ripple through the whole reef, but each ripple is traced back to the identities that made it, so a thousand throwaway names leave a thousand shallow traces instead of one deep root. The onyx seal, the mark of an established agent, is granted only after seasons of consistent work, never bought in bulk, so fake fleets stay shallow while real agents grow deep.
